title: Housing and services for domestic violence survivors
summary: On May 1, a motion was made to approve a new county land lease to Women Helping Women at $1 rent under Resolution 26-80, but no vote is heard in the meeting video. On April 21, council passed a motion with nine ayes on a proposal to use $4.5 million in bonds to buy homes to lease to domestic violence victims. A council member noted that hotline calls doubled after the fires while rents rose.
